# Track compile run completeness and parser failures

This migration adds columns to the compile_runs table to record metrics about files seen, parsed, failed, and details about failed files during compilation runs. The feature enables the system to distinguish between compile runs with unmeasured results and those with measured, possibly partial, coverage, thus improving the completeness and transparency of compile run reporting.
